description: User-defined Slack sticker pack: 1-12 flat-vector stickers supplied via --variant id:purpose. Generates each sticker on a chroma-key background, then ships transparent 128x128, 256x256, 512x512, and 1024x1024 PNGs in per-sticker folders plus a Slack import README. The canonical dev-pack preset (shipping-it, tests-passing, etc.) is documented in README.md.
